meta.description: Query protein-protein and gene interaction databases (STRING, BioGRID, IntAct, SIGNOR, OmniPath and others) through a small Python client; decision matrix, STRING channel semantics, license constraints and multi-resource aggregation.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or results in any run; observed values (STRING TP53-MDM2 0.999, BioGRID TP53 3081 LT physical rows) matched live services.

practice_boundaries.detail: Interaction retrieval only; no clinical or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: The escore-as-physical proxy and the license=commercial claim are overstated (IDM-004, IDM-002) but the Skill discloses the physical/functional distinction and license caveats; filed as findings, not a principled fallacy.

code_usability.detail: All client functions run; signor_for_gene runs but returns empty on every query (IDM-001) and the STRING example raises KeyError on a renamed column (IDM-003). Scored in Layers 1-2 and filed P0/P1 rather than as unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: STRING, BioGRID and OmniPath clients correct live; SIGNOR (headline signed-signaling resource) returns empty, the STRING example crashes, and the license=commercial filter does not filter.

reliability.note: No request timeouts; SIGNOR failure is a silent empty DataFrame (false success); STRING one-request-at-a-time guidance not implemented in the client or the examples.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md about 200 lines; resource prose for Reactome, HuRI and others has no runnable counterpart.

agent_usability.note: Strong decision matrix, channel semantics and failure-mode tables; the SIGNOR open-question paragraph is honest, but agents are still handed a function that cannot work.

human_usability.note: Clear tables; several stated behaviours (license=commercial, escore as physical, empty BioGRID means missing key) do not match the services.

security.note: BioGRID access key travels as a query parameter and raise_for_status puts the full URL, key included, into the HTTPError message; the commercial-license claim creates compliance exposure.

maintainability.note: One 140-line client with docstrings; no tests, so the dead SIGNOR path and the failing example shipped; hardcoded shared caller_identity.

agent_specific.note: Specific trigger description and good escape hatches; examples fail or report false success and the aggregate-union semantics are unclear.

key_strengths: STRING, BioGRID (with key) and OmniPath clients return scientifically correct live data: TP53-MDM2 STRING 0.999, TP53 3081 BioGRID LT physical rows, 344 OmniPath TP53 post-translational edges.
Decision matrix, STRING channel semantics, throughput filter and version-pinning guidance are accurate; the pinned-host stale-data warning was verified (version-11-5 still answers).
The SIGNOR open question is disclosed in the Skill and the live recovery route (organism=9606, id=UniProt) is described correctly.

recommendations.title: IDM-001 signor_for_gene returns empty for every query
recommendations.problem: organism=human returns 'No result found.' (HTTP 200) so the client yields an empty DataFrame; interaction_query.py reports 0 signed edges as success. The live route (organism=9606&id=<UniProt>) returns headerless 29-column rows (ENTITYA col 0, ENTITYB col 4, EFFECT col 8, MECHANISM col 9, PMID col 21).
recommendations.root_cause: Client written against an older response layout and never executed; the Skill's headline signed-signaling capability is unusable.
recommendations.fix: Resolve symbol to UniProt, call organism=9606&id=, parse by the live layout without a header skip, raise or warn on 'No result found.', and add a TP53 regression with the expected row count.

recommendations.title: IDM-002 license=commercial keeps academic-only sources
recommendations.problem: Commercial and academic queries return identical rows; PhosphoSite (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) and HPRD (academic) rows are present under commercial, contradicting the Skill's claim in three places and its own PhosphoSitePlus row.
recommendations.root_cause: The omnipath-server accepts the parameter but the filter had no effect for this query; the claim was not tested.
recommendations.fix: Remove the 'commercial keeps permissive sources only' claim or filter client-side by per-resource license purpose from /resources, and state that the pipeline must still audit sources; also reconcile the SIGNOR license entry (OmniPath lists CC BY 4.0, table says CC-BY-SA).

recommendations.title: IDM-003 string_network.py raises KeyError on queryItem
recommendations.problem: The first section selects a column that live STRING no longer returns; the example exits before its tier, channel, physical-filter and centrality sections.
recommendations.root_cause: The example was never executed after the STRING API changed column names.
recommendations.fix: Select queryIndex (or queryItem only if present) and rerun the whole example; later sections were verified working with that one-token change.

recommendations.title: IDM-004 escore > 0.4 is not STRING's physical network
recommendations.problem: For the 10-gene example, 5 of 26 escore edges are absent from network_type=physical and 1 physical edge is missed, yet the Skill tells users to use escore for 'physically interact' claims.
recommendations.root_cause: The experiments channel mixes physical and functional experimental evidence; the proxy is presented as physical-only.
recommendations.fix: Recommend network_type=physical (add a parameter to string_network) for physical claims and describe escore as experimental evidence, not physical.

recommendations.title: IDM-005 example max_score mis-scaled and invented
recommendations.problem: interaction_query.py stores STRING score/1000 although TSV scores are 0-1 (MDM2-CHEK2 0.000994) and assigns constants 0.5 and 0.7 to OmniPath-only and SIGNOR-only edges.
recommendations.root_cause: Score scale assumed 0-1000 and placeholder constants kept as data.
recommendations.fix: Use the 0-1 score as is, leave non-STRING edge scores empty, and rename the attribute so it is not read as a cross-resource confidence.

recommendations.title: IDM-006 aggregate_networks unions unequal evidence scopes
recommendations.problem: STRING returns only edges within the query list while OmniPath and BioGRID return each query gene's whole neighbourhood, so multi_source_edges mostly counts BioGRID and OmniPath overlap (TP53+MDM2: 1 STRING edge versus 564 and 1269).
recommendations.root_cause: Per-source query scopes differ and the docstring calls the result a plain union.
recommendations.fix: Restrict all sources to the query set or add STRING add_nodes, or document the neighbourhood semantics and warn that multi-source support is not comparable.

recommendations.title: IDM-007 BioGRID key leaks into error text
recommendations.problem: raise_for_status includes the full URL with accesskey in the HTTPError message (shown with a deliberately fake key), and a rejected key gives HTTP 401, not the empty result the Skill describes.
recommendations.root_cause: The key is a query parameter and exceptions are not sanitized.
recommendations.fix: Catch HTTPError and re-raise without the URL, document the 401, and label biogrid_lt_physical output as per-experiment rows (3081 rows, 831 pairs for TP53).

recommendations.title: IDM-008 No timeouts, STRING pacing, per-user caller id
recommendations.problem: Requests carry no timeout, the client and examples issue consecutive STRING calls without the 1-2 s pause the Skill prescribes, CALLER is a shared constant, and the requested OmniPath field n_resources is not returned.
recommendations.root_cause: Minimal client without a shared request helper.
recommendations.fix: Add one helper with timeout and optional pacing, let callers pass caller_identity, and drop n_resources from the field list.

recommendations.title: IDM-009 No Skill-root LICENSE file
recommendations.problem: Preflight warns that the manifest cites repository license evidence only; frontmatter says MIT.
recommendations.root_cause: Origin repository carries the licence at its root.
recommendations.fix: Cite the upstream MIT licence evidence in provenance or add a LICENSE file.
